thread:
sam: kicking off KnitWave deploy now — target: v2.14.0 staged -> canary (API, runtime, router, console). pinging owners for quick checks.

maria: on it. runtime has the batching kernel flip; I've pinned a compatible build (runtime:v2.14.0-rc3) and ran a perf sweep. baseline looks good for 8k seq but watch KV eviction.

alex: router team ready but need header-swap flag enabled in console before we shift traffic. that's the only hard coupling.

irene: console schema migration will be rolled with a feature-flag. login path smoke tests passed locally but i saw one flaky 502 in staging earlier. will re-run.

sam: plan: staged deploy to idle pool -> canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. rollout order: API -> runtime -> router -> console. if any step fails, we rollback that service and stop. rollback criteria: 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m OR median p95 latency regresses > 10%. agreed?

maria: agreed. also suggest temporary KV cache TTL bump during canary to reduce eviction churn. can toggle via runtime env var.

alex: ack. router will wait for console header flag. i'll hold router pin until console confirms header-split ready.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by sam: /deploy knitwave v2.14.0 --staged --owners @sam,@maria,@alex,@irene --order api,runtime,router,console

ops-lead: leaving a note: if we hit a cross-service mismatch (schema vs runtime), prefer to unpin console first and keep runtime pinned. console changes are backwards-compatible behind flag.

deploy-bot: staged deploy to idle pool completed: api:v2.14.0 staged -> OK 

sam: kicking canary for API now.

deploy-bot: canary (API) started: 10% traffic -> api:v2.14.0

maria: runtime staged now. applying TTL bump: RUNTIME_KV_TTL=60m -> 180m for canary.

deploy-bot: runtime canary started: runtime:v2.14.0-rc3 (10% traffic)

maria: running perf probe: qps steady, p95 +3%, cpu up ~6%. within threshold.

irene: console: re-ran login smoke. one 502 on attempt #3 still reproducible. investigating stack traces, looks like header parsing NPE when header-split flag off.

alex: that's the header dependency i called out. router can't safely route header-split traffic yet. we should hold router and console until irene confirms fix.

sam: hold router and console canary. do not progress router pin. Proceeding to increase API/runtime canary to 50% only.

deploy-bot: canary update: api:v2.14.0 -> 50%, runtime:v2.14.0-rc3 -> 50%

maria: perf still stable at 50%: p95 +4%. TTL bump reduced eviction events. good.

irene: quick patch pushed to console branch: guard on header parsing. will deploy hotfix to staging and re-run smoke.

deploy-bot: console hotfix staging deploy completed.

irene: staging smoke now clean (no 502s in 30m). ready for canary when you unblock router.

alex: i'll enable header-swap flag in router staging and run canary checks against console hotfix. once green, i'll pin router.

sam: ok — finalize decision: continue API/runtime to 100% if stable. hold router/console until router verifies header-swap compatibility. release notes draft: "KnitWave v2.14.0 — batching kernel, KV TTL tuning, console header-split behind flag. No user downtime expected."

maria: +1 on notes. add migration note: "If you rely on custom headers, test header-split compatibility."

deploy-bot: canary metrics check at 50%: api p95 within +5%, errors 0.12% (below threshold), runtime p95 +4%, cpu within limits.

sam: green to push API/runtime to 100%.

deploy-bot: progressing to 100%: api:v2.14.0 -> 100% ; runtime:v2.14.0-rc3 -> 100%

maria: runtime fully rolled. will monitor for 30m.

alex: router staging flag tests passed. starting router canary (10%) pointed at console hotfix.

deploy-bot: router canary started: router:v1.10.0-canary -> 10%

irene: console canary started with hotfix behind flag. login smoke clean.

deploy-bot: router canary metrics at 10%: tail latency +2%, no 5xx.

alex: increasing router to 50%

deploy-bot: router 50% -> metrics stable.

sam: once router at 50% and console smoke holds for 15m, we can finish console to 100% and close release. ensure release notes published and changelog updated.

ops-lead: reminder: tag the rollout in incident channel if any regressions. also add a quick post-deploy checklist: telemetry baseline, error budgets, and rollback window closed.

maria: monitoring looks clean at 30m post-rollout for runtime. I'll keep alerts on for next 2 hours.

sam: good work. final step: publish release notes and mark knitwave v2.14.0 as GA in the catalog when console hits 100%.

deploy-bot: router -> 100% done. console -> 100% done. release complete: KnitWave v2.14.0 rolled to prod.

sam: thanks all. follow-up: retro tomorrow 10am — small note: add header-split smoke to preflight so we avoid hold next time.

irene: noted. will add to preflight checklist and automated smoke scripts. :white_check_mark:

alex: same — will add router->console contract test to suite.

maria: will add a quick perf probe to auto-bail if p95 > +8% during canary.

ops-lead: logging the rollwave in release tracker. no rollback needed. :thumbsup:
